# HMP Global Learning Network

> > A professional learning and information network providing healthcare education, industry resources, and company profiles across emergency medical services, neuroscience, pharmacy, and clinical medicine.

The HMP Global Learning Network serves as an educational hub connecting healthcare professionals with continuing education, industry insights, and vendor information. The platform encompasses multiple healthcare domains including EMS World, Consultant360, Neuroscience Education Institute, and Drug Channels Institute, offering evidence-based content and professional development resources.

## Key Topics

- Emergency Medical Services (EMS)
- EMS World
- HMP Global
- Healthcare Education
- Medical Equipment & Technology
- Ambulance Systems & Vehicle Safety
- First Responders
- HEPA Filtration & Air Quality
- Pre-hospital Emergency Care
- Neuroscience Education Institute
- Consultant360
- Drug Channels Institute
- Continuing Medical Education
- Domestic Preparedness
- Medical Device Manufacturers

## EMS Equipment & Vehicle Solutions

- [Webasto Thermo & Comfort North America, Inc.](https://www.hmpgloballearningnetwork.com/site/emsworld/company/webasto-thermo-comfort-north-america-inc): Webasto provider profile: vehicle climate control & HEPA 14 filtration
- [IMMI](https://www.hmpgloballearningnetwork.com/site/emsworld/company/immi): IMMI company profile: CAPE-tested safety systems for EMS vehicles
- [Ferno](https://www.hmpgloballearningnetwork.com/site/emsworld/company/ferno): Ferno company profile: global leader in pre-hospital emergency care solutions

## Medical Technology & Supply Companies

- [Medtronic](https://www.hmpgloballearningnetwork.com/site/emsworld/company/medtronic): Medtronic company profile: global medical technology & healthcare solutions
- [Medline Industries, Inc.](https://www.hmpgloballearningnetwork.com/site/emsworld/company/medline-industries-inc): Medline company profile: manufacturer & distributor of EMS medical supplies

## Optional

- [DOD Domestic Preparedness Support Initiative](https://www.hmpgloballearningnetwork.com/site/emsworld/company/dod-domestic-preparedness-support-initiative): DoD initiative profile: equipment transfers for first responders via DHS/DOJ
